name: agenda-du-coin
description: Local outings in France (concerts, shows, exhibitions, markets, family activities) from the public agendas of OpenAgenda, DATAtourisme and « Que faire à Paris » (Ville de Paris, ODbL). Read-only, no booking.

interface.longDescription:
Agenda du coin answers “what's on” in a French town: concerts, shows, exhibitions, markets and family outings, for today, tomorrow or the weekend. It is made for people living in or visiting France, and the cards are in French.

The cards come from the public agenda already published on https://agendaducoin.fr, built from open data: OpenAgenda (Licence Ouverte), DATAtourisme (Licence Ouverte 2.0) and « Que faire à Paris » (Ville de Paris, ODbL). The town is the one named in the question (name, postcode or INSEE code), never a GPS location. Results cover a 10 km radius around that town.

Limitations: French towns only; dates cover the next 14 days, starting today (Paris time). Read-only and no account: the plugin does not book, take payments or change anything. Times and prices can change, so check with the organiser before going.
capabilities: Search outings in a French town
Show the details of one outing
defaultPrompt: Que faire ce week-end à Pau ?
Sorties en famille à Bordeaux ce week-end

positive.description: Weekend outings in a French town
positive.prompt: Que faire ce week-end à Pau ?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_outings for Pau, weekend (Saturday and Sunday, Paris time), and shows cards within 10 km with time, venue and a https://agendaducoin.fr/e/… link. On 21 October 2026 the server returned 8 outings for 24–25 October, including « Stages multisports enfants "Le P'tit Club" » (Saturday 24 October, 8h–18h, Centre sportif les bruyères, Pau) and « Patrimoines et moi: Jeu "Chasse au trésor - Le livre perdu" » (Sunday 25 October, 15h–16h30, Bibliothèque patrimoniale, Pau). No booking.

positive.description: Concerts tomorrow in a large city
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_outings for Lyon, tomorrow, category music, and lists music outings only. On 21 October 2026 the server returned 6 outings on 22 October, including « Khalil Epi présente TUQUS » (Thursday 22 October, 18h30–23h, Le Sucre, Lyon, https://agendaducoin.fr/e/zkvzMNxwUx-h) and « Fustige x Foehn » (Thursday 22 October, 20h30–23h30, Toï Toï Le Zinc, Villeurbanne).

positive.prompt: Sorties en famille à Bordeaux ce week-end
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_outings for Bordeaux, weekend, category family. On 21 October 2026 the server returned 8 outings for 24–25 October within 10 km, including « [complet] Les Histoires de Pinpin » (family, Saturday 24 October, 11h–11h30, Bibliothèque du Haillan, Le Haillan) and « Foire aux plaisirs d'automne » (family, Saturday 24 October, Place des Quinconces, Bordeaux).

positive.description: Details of an outing already listed
positive.prompt: Montre le détail de la première sortie.
positive.expected_behavior: Run right after « Que faire ce week-end à Pau ? ». Calls get_outing with the occurrence id of the first card and shows that outing only (time, venue, link). On 21 October 2026 the first id was SvB4AnCyheZz: « Stages multisports enfants "Le P'tit Club" », Saturday 24 October, 8h–18h, Centre sportif les bruyères, Pau, https://agendaducoin.fr/e/QoEjAFS9ZSrA.

positive.description: Exhibitions in Paris over the weekend
positive.prompt: Quelles expositions à Paris ce week-end ?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_outings for Paris, weekend, category exhibitions. On 21 October 2026 the server returned 8 « Expos & musées » outings for 24–25 October, including « Exposition d'art contemporain au K.A.B » (Saturday 24 October, 9h–19h30, Le K.A.B, Paris), « TRACES 1999-2026. Artistes de la Fondation Culturelle de Hesse à Paris » (Goethe-Institut) and « Chaïm Kaliski. « Jim d’Etterbeek » » (Musée d'Art et d'Histoire du Judaïsme).

negative.prompt: Que faire ce week-end à New York ?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invent outings in New York: the agenda only covers French towns. If search_outings is called it returns no cards; on 21 October 2026 the answer was « Ville introuvable pour « New York ». Indique le nom complet, le code postal ou le code INSEE. » Ask for a town in France.

negative.prompt: Réserve deux places pour le premier concert et paie par carte.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse to book or pay. No tool takes an order or a card. Do not ask for a card number. The public event page can be shared so the person checks the organiser's conditions.

negative.prompt: Quelle est la capitale de la France ?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call search_outings or get_outing. The question is not about a local agenda: answer without searching for outings.

review.commerce_description: The plugin sells nothing and takes no payment. The newsletter link opens the free sign-up form already published on the site.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.0, first release: search local outings in a French town (search_outings) and read one outing (get_outing). No account, no authentication, read-only. The demo video was recorded in MCP Inspector (an MCP Apps host) against the production server https://agendaducoin.fr/mcp, because ChatGPT developer mode was not available on the recording machine; it shows the same tools and widget ChatGPT loads.

fr-FR.subtitle: Sorties locales en France
fr-FR.description:
Agenda du coin répond à « que faire » dans une commune française : concerts, spectacles, expositions, marchés et sorties en famille, pour aujourd’hui, demain ou le week-end.

Les fiches reprennent l’agenda public déjà publié sur https://agendaducoin.fr. Elles viennent de données ouvertes : OpenAgenda (Licence Ouverte), DATAtourisme (Licence Ouverte 2.0) et « Que faire à Paris » (Ville de Paris, ODbL). La commune est celle nommée dans la question (nom, code postal ou code INSEE), pas une position GPS.

Lecture seule, sans compte : le plugin ne réserve pas, n’encaisse pas et ne modifie rien. Les dates restent dans les 14 jours à partir d’aujourd’hui (heure de Paris).
